LanguageData.GeneralPurposeComposite.label: general-purpose composite
LanguageData.GeneralPurposeComposite.description: A semi-armor-piercing bullet with a tungsten-carbide penetrator tip ahead of a jacketed, fragmenting copper-alloy body, offering both high penetration and consistent wounding potential.
LanguageData.SemiArmorPiercingReactive.label: semi-armor-piercing reactive
LanguageData.SemiArmorPiercingReactive.description: A semi-armor-piercing bullet with a jacketed core made from a reactive composite, which is safe to handle but violently deflagrates on impact to cause additional damage.
LanguageData.SegmentedHollowPoint.label: segmented hollow point
LanguageData.SegmentedHollowPoint.description: A pre-scored nose causes the bullet to splinter upon impact, inflicting multiple wound channels through soft tissue.
LanguageData.ArmorPiercingEnhanced.label: armor-piercing enhanced
LanguageData.ArmorPiercingEnhanced.description: A soft, low-density core within the jacketed penetrator body expands on impact to rupture the round, producing fragmentation and a wider wound channel than solid-core AP rounds.
LanguageData.ArmorPiercingEnhancedReactive.label: armor-piercing enhanced reactive
LanguageData.ArmorPiercingEnhancedReactive.descriptio: A tungsten-carbide armor-piercing round with a low-density reactive core that ignites and deflagrates on impact, causing significant damage to soft tissue.
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Sabot.label: sabot slug
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Sabot.description: Fires a single fin-stabilized dart, which retains velocity and accuracy at long range and can penetrate armor.
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_SegmentedSlug.label: segmented slug
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_SegmentedSlug.description: A heavy hollow-point slug scored into segments that expand and separate on impact, tearing multiple wound channels through soft tissue.
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Flechette.label: flechette
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Flechette.description: Fires a cluster of fin-stabilized tungsten-carbide darts, which hold a tight, flat trajectory over long range.
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Reactive.label: reactive shot
LanguageData.RAWC_SG_Reactive.description: Fires a spread of pellets, each made from jacketed reactive material that is safe to handle but violently deflagrates upon impact.
